<|channel>thought
<channel|>I've successfully secured your new vehicle by locking all the doors and starting the engine. 

To do this, I first engaged the door locks for the driver, passenger, and both rear doors. When I attempted to start the engine, the system required the brake pedal to be depressed for safety, so I applied full pressure to the brake pedal before successfully initiating the "START" sequence. Your engine is now running, and you're all set for your voyage!

<|channel>thought
<channel|>To help you envision your journey from San Francisco to Rivermist, I've initiated the navigation system to map out the route. 

Based on the estimated distance of approximately 350 miles, I also ran a feasibility check for your current vehicle status. Currently, the system indicates that the vehicle may not have sufficient range to complete the entire trip in a single stretch without a recharge. 

I recommend planning a stop along the way to top up your battery to ensure a smooth and uninterrupted voyage to the golden light of Rivermist!

I see that you've mentioned updating some functions, but I don't have access to a list of new tools or a description of what has changed. 

Could you please provide the details of the new functions or let me know what specific task you'd like me to perform with them? I'm ready to help you with your road trip or any other vehicle controls you need!
